_comment: Probe roster for rosterIssues(), which every other acceptance bypasses: the carry fixtures inject CARRY_FIXTURE_ROSTER as a Map, so the function that reads the real wave-*-groups.json files was pinned by nothing. 990010 is the int every roster uses today. "990011" and "990012" are the numeric strings a typo produces, and reading only ints let one hand that stage a second destination in silence; there are TWO of them so the over-fire control cannot be met by a reader that maps every string to one constant. "NA" is that control: a non-numeric entry must index nothing, or the widening became a rule claiming every roster covers every issue.
